course1.title: Mastery of Systemic Constellations
course1.subtitle: Deep therapeutic approach for working with family systems
course1.description: The constellation method is a therapeutic approach developed by German psychotherapist Bert Hellinger, aimed at identifying and resolving deep family or systemic problems. The main idea of the method is that many of our emotional and psychological problems may be related to disturbances in the family system, including unconscious patterns that are passed down from generation to generation.

modules.title: Session 1: Introduction to Systemic Constellations
modules.content:
• History and foundations of systemic constellations
• Principles of the systemic approach
• Introduction to family dynamics and ancestral scenarios
• Examples of successful applications of constellations
• Preparation for working with clients
  - Creating a safe space
  - Establishing trust
  - Formulating the request

modules.title: Session 2: Working with the Field
modules.content:
• The concept of field in systemic constellations
• Techniques for working with the field
  - Tuning into the field
  - Reading information from the field
  - Managing field energy
• Systemic field and quantum physics
• Universal laws and breaking through the law of Octaves
• Practical exercise "Feeling the Field"

benefits: Methods for working through resentments and blocks

course2.title: Developmental Psychology
course2.subtitle: Comprehensive course on developmental psychology
course2.description: This course is dedicated to studying the basic patterns of human psychological development throughout life. You will learn about various theories of development, features of different age periods, and learn to apply this knowledge in practical work with clients of different ages.

modules.title: Module 1: Introduction to Developmental Psychology
modules.content:
• Subject and tasks of developmental psychology
• Research methods in developmental psychology
• Basic theories of mental development
• Periodization of mental development

modules.title: Module 2: Prenatal Period and Infancy
modules.content:
• Features of prenatal development
• Newborn crisis
• Development of mental functions in infancy
• Formation of the first forms of communication

benefits: Practical methods for working with different age groups
Diagnostic tools for determining developmental levels

course3.title: NLP Practitioner
course3.subtitle: Effective techniques for communication and personal growth
course3.description: Studying NLP helps develop effective communication skills, including the ability to listen, recognize and understand non-verbal signals, and adapt your communication style to the interlocutor. With NLP, you can learn to quickly create and maintain trusting relationships with people, which is useful in personal life, business, and social interactions.

modules.title: Module 1: Basic NLP
modules.content:
• Basic concepts and techniques of NLP
  - Representational systems
  - Submodalities
  - Rapport
  - Framing
  - Anchoring

• Lesson 1: Fundamental Foundations of NLP
  - What is NLP and its history
  - Fundamental rules of NLP
  - Representational systems
  - Determining the leading representational system

modules.title: Module 2: NLP Master
modules.content:
• Advanced techniques and strategies of NLP for deep work

• Lesson 1: Working with the Unconscious
  - In-depth understanding of unconscious processes
  - Three-position perception technique
  - Practice of working with different perspectives
  - Integration of perception positions

course4.title: Regression: Immersion in Soul Memory and Multiverse
course4.subtitle: Journey into past lives, ancestral channels, and interincarnational space
course4.description: This course will teach you how to conduct deep regressions into past lives, ancestral channels, alien worlds, and interincarnational space. You will master working with entities, karmic nodes, and multidimensional healing. The course is designed for those who feel the call of the Soul, strive for deep self-knowledge, and want to learn how to help themselves and others regain power, memory, and access to the true path of the Soul.

modules.title: Module 1: Awareness of the Soul's Path
modules.content:
• What is regression: past lives, ancestry, interincarnational space, star memory
• How the field, subconscious, and Spiritual memory work
• Practice: meditation "Contact with Soul Chronicles"
• Preparation for immersions: energy, protection, guides

modules.title: Module 2: Soul Mission, Higher Self, and Quantum Transitions
modules.content:
• What is the Soul Mission:
  - The difference between "karma" and "purpose"
  - How the Soul chooses lessons, family, body, circumstances
  - Why not all missions are related to profession

• Who is the Higher Self:
  - Soul structure: Personality — Soul — Spirit — Higher Self
  - How to receive answers, support, and guidance from the Higher Self
  - Connection with inner guide and spiritual navigation
  - Setting up the Higher Self channel for the client and for yourself

benefits: Working with past lives and karmic connections
Healing emotional and physical problems through multidimensional healing
Working with the Higher Self and soul guides

course5.title: Practical Psychology
course5.subtitle: Comprehensive course on the fundamentals of psychology in practice
course5.description: This course provides a systematic introduction to practical psychology. You will learn the basics of psychological counseling, methods of diagnosing and solving various psychological problems, and master practical skills of working with clients.

modules.title: Module 1: Introduction to Practical Psychology
modules.content:
• Basic principles and methods of practical psychology
• Ethics of psychological counseling
• Setting up the consultation process
• Building rapport with the client

modules.title: Module 2: Communication and Interviewing Techniques
modules.content:
• Active listening skills
• Types of questions and their application
• Effective feedback techniques
• Managing difficult conversations

benefits: Confident use of practical psychological methods
